status: NOT IN USE - REJECTED NEGATIVE RESULT (Phase 2)
rationale: Evaluated during Phase 2 speed recalibration. Rejected because baseline (11.59% median / 32.56% P90) outperformed f-only (11.46% / 41.10% P90) and f+alpha (12.34% / 32.78% P90). Furthermore, on held-out trips baseline won clearly (8.73% vs 9.86% and 9.18%) and f degraded the >50 km/h regime on both held-out trips (S-S3a bias -2.02 -> -3.19 m/s, RMSE 3.31 -> 4.08 m/s; S-S4 bias -5.48 -> -6.50 m/s). Not used in production inference pipeline.
